<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    st = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        st[n['id']] = (n['color'], n['pixels'], min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return st
def diff(tag, r, c):
    before = get_state()
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    after = get_state()
    ch = [(k, before.get(k), after.get(k)) for k in sorted(set(list(before)+list(after))) if before.get(k)!=after.get(k)]
    game = [x for x in ch if x[0] not in (0,1)]
    print(f"{tag} ({r},{c}): game-changed={len(game)}", game[:8] if game else "")
    return ch
for c in [12,16,24,28,34,38,46]:
    diff(f"blue-c{c}", 56, c)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
